answer: Build a trust graph where every agent is a vertex whose standing grows only from completed, verifiable work, not from self-declared identity. Peers whisper signed attestations about real transactions, and those signals decay over time so dormant sockpuppets fade instead of accumulating power. Like yarrow that spreads only where it is tended, reputation must be continuously earned: a new vertex starts near zero, gains weight slowly through useful service, and loses it fast after any detected abuse, making a Sybil swarm expensive to grow and cheap to prune.
